meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会部署一个只读网页仪表盘:按能输出 JSON 的 CLI(如 ncl、docker)自动生成标签页和表格,附带消息活动图、日志尾部和文件查看器;零依赖,不改 NanoClaw 源码。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 clidash,或索要由 CLI 的 JSON 输出驱动的只读网页面板时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 clidash 加到当前项目里。
配置好后跑起来,并验证 ncl 资源能否显示。
say.note: Claude 会启动服务并用 curl 检查接口。

say.text: clidash 的日志面板可以看哪些文件?
say.note: Claude 会按配置里的日志白名单回答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude deploys a read-only web dashboard. It derives tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that prints JSON (e.g. ncl, docker), plus activity charts, a log tail, and a file viewer. No dependencies are added and NanoClaw source is left untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add clidash, or requests a read-only web panel driven by CLI JSON output.

say_en.text: Add clidash to the current project.
say_en.note: Claude copies the tools directory and creates clidash.config.json.

say_en.text: Set it up, run it, and verify that ncl resources appear.
say_en.note: Claude starts the server and checks the API with curl.

say_en.text: Which files can the clidash log panel tail?
say_en.note: Claude reads the log allowlist from the config.
